verification_type_definitions.field_verified: Complete installation running in production and documented; see /case-studies/
verification_type_definitions.bench_tested: Battery + inverter tested together on BMS-EV bench with the exact firmware build
verification_type_definitions.protocol_verified: Pack protocol documented in a public open-source implementation or teardown; firmware built and bench-tested against it
verification_type_definitions.engineering_validated: Firmware profile exists and is bench-tested before dispatch; no public protocol source attached to the record yet

meta.dedup_note: 41 duplicate battery+inverter pairs removed on 2026-09-19. They originated from the WooCommerce catalogue export, where a product can appear under more than one category. Previous published totals of 3815 combinations and a compatible_inverters value of 95 for Tesla Model S & X (2012-2020) were inflated by those duplicates.
meta.verification_date_note: verification_date is the date the verification_type on that row was assigned, not the date each individual pairing was exercised. field_verified rows carry the date of the field observation. protocol_verified and engineering_validated rows carry 2026-09-19, when the verification levels were reviewed and assigned across the dataset against firmware 15.0.14. It does not mean every pair was tested on that day.
